description.zh: 节点所在区域。参数说明：运营商-大洲-城市
description.en: The back-to-origin mark of the node group. The value is in the format of Carrier-Continent-City, which is used to identify the origin of back-to-origin requests.
The ID of the Hybrid Cloud WAF cluster.
The name of the node group.

description.zh:
节点组类型。取值范围如下：
- **protect**：防护。

- **control**：管控。

- **storage**：存储。

- **controlStorage**：管控＆存储。
description.en:
The type of the node group. Valid values:

- **protect**: a protection node group that processes traffic filtering.

- **control**: a control node group that manages cluster configurations.

- **storage**: a storage node group that stores logs and data.

- **controlStorage**: a node group that serves as both control and storage.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.
The IP address of the load balancer that is associated with the node group.

description.zh: 节点所在区域。参数说明：运营商-大洲-城市
description.en: The location code of the region where the node group resides. The value is in the format of Carrier-Continent-City.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值范围如下：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The remarks on the node group. You can use this parameter to add a brief description for the node group.
The ID of the resource group.

title.zh: 创建混合云集群节点组信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi create-hybrid-cloud-group --instance-id waf-cn-n6w000x52m --cluster-id 1 --group-name test --group-type protect --load-balance-ip 3.3.3.3 --remark test --location-code 0-410-0 --back-source-mark aliyun-asiapacific-beijing --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi CreateHybridCloudGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName test --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --LoadBalanceIp '3.3.3.3' --BackSourceMark 'aliyun-asiapacific-beijing' --GroupType protect --InstanceId 'waf-cn-n6w000x52m' --ClusterId 1 --LocationCode '0-410-0' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Remark test
